items.name: Delimited
items.summary: A `MakeVisitor` wrapper that wraps a visitor that writes formatted output so that a delimiter is inserted between writing formatted field values.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(delimiter: D, inner: V) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new [`MakeVisitor`] implementation that wraps `inner` so that it will format each visited field separated by the provided `delimiter`.

items.name: VisitDelimited
items.summary: A visitor wrapper that inserts a delimiter after the wrapped visitor formats a field value.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(delimiter: D, inner: V) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new [`Visit`] implementation that wraps `inner` so that each formatted field is separated by the provided `delimiter`.
